hero.title: Secondary market for shares: sales between shareholders recorded in the register
hero.description: Sttok organises sales between shareholders and purchase offers to several shareholders at once. Each completed transaction is entered in the shareholder register with its documents. It is an add-on module.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about the secondary market

items.a: A module for organising share sales between shareholders and purchase offers to several shareholders at once.
Shareholders and investors authorised by the company, with the permissions it sets.
In the shareholder register, against the transferred ranges, with its documents.

items.q: Is it included in the plans?
items.a: No. It is an add-on module available on any plan.

items.q: Does it work for companies in Latin America?
items.a: The platform adapts to each country's terminology: shareholder ledger, general shareholders' meeting, board of directors. Compliance with each country's regulations is assessed case by case.

includes.title: How the secondary market works in Sttok

situations.title: Common situations in the secondary market

rows.situation: A shareholder wants to sell and cannot find a buyer
rows.action: They publish a sell offer to the shareholders the company authorises.

rows.situation: The company wants to give several shareholders liquidity
rows.action: It makes a purchase offer to several shareholders at once, with price and deadline.

rows.situation: The articles provide for a pre-emption right
rows.action: The transfer follows the notices and deadlines set in the articles of association.
It is recorded in the register against the transferred ranges, with its documents.
